questions.q: Kunwar Singh is remembered in 1857 primarily for operations around:
questions.solution: Correct option: B. Age, guerrilla style, alliance with sepoys. Pair with Babu Amar Singh.

questions.q: The Kosi is often called the ‘sorrow of Bihar’ because of:
options: Shifting course, heavy sediment and floods
questions.solution: Correct option: B. Avulsion + embankment politics + disaster management.

questions.q: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment is related to:
questions.solution: Correct option: B. Part IX, 11th Schedule. Bihar PRIs and women’s reservation are standard follow-ups.

questions.q: A major feature of Bihar’s contemporary economy is:
options: Highest factory share in India always
High out-migration and remittance dependence with a thin industrial base
questions.solution: Correct option: B. Use Economic Survey of Bihar numbers when you quote.

questions.q: Madhubani (Mithila) painting traditionally uses:
options: Only oil on canvas in Paris
Natural colours and ritual-wall/paper painting of Mithila
Only Mughal miniature paper from Agra
questions.solution: Correct option: B. GI and livelihood; do not confuse with Kalighat or Kalamkari.

questions.q: Arsenic contamination in parts of the Ganga plains is mainly linked to:
questions.solution: Correct option: B. Public-health geography: wells, mitigation, surface-water options.

questions.q: Champaran Satyagraha (1917) was directed against:
questions.solution: Correct option: B. Enquiry, agreement, first satyagraha in India.

questions.q: Discuss the significance of Magadha in the making of the first pan-Indian state.
questions.solution: Iron, elephants, Ganga–Son, Nanda–Maurya administration, spies and revenue. Ashoka’s dhamma as public communication. Archaeological: Rajgir, Kumrahar.

questions.q: Evaluate the contribution of Bihar in the Revolt of 1857.
questions.solution: Kunwar Singh, Arrah siege, Danapur sepoys. Peasant–taluqdar mix. Aftermath: Crown rule, army reorganisation. Local, not a footnote to Meerut.

questions.q: Explain the flood problem of North Bihar and suggest a sustainable strategy.
questions.solution: Himalayan rivers, sediment, embankment-induced waterlogging. Mix: warning, shelters, room for the river, transboundary data with Nepal, insurance, not only higher bunds.

questions.q: Account for out-migration from Bihar. What state policies can make growth more job-rich?
questions.solution: Push: land, floods, weak industry. Pull: Punjab, Delhi, Gulf. Skills, food processing, logistics, tourism (Nalanda–Bodh Gaya), urban services. Remittances as a bridge, not a destiny.

questions.q: Examine the working of Panchayati Raj in Bihar after the 73rd Amendment.
questions.solution: Reservations, mukhiya politics, funds/functions/functionaries gap, parallel missions. Success: participation of women. Reform: own revenues, audit, Gram Sabha vitality.

questions.q: A District Magistrate faces pressure to inflate flood-relief lists. What values will guide you?
questions.solution: Integrity, compassion for the real poor, courage, objectivity. Tools: SECC, geo-tag, social audit, written file. Communicate why lists were trimmed. No party colour.

questions.q: Write a note on Nalanda as a centre of learning and its contemporary relevance.
questions.solution: Mahavihara, patrons, Xuanzang, curriculum, destruction narratives with care. New Nalanda University: internationalisation vs heritage conservation.

questions.q: Champaran Satyagraha was more than an indigo dispute. Discuss.
questions.solution: Planters, tinkathia, peasant evidence, Gandhi’s method, nationalisation of a local grievance. Template for later satyagrahas.

questions.q: Discuss caste and politics in Bihar without partisanship.
questions.solution: Social justice coalitions, census debate, development vs identity. GS needs institutions and dignity, not slogans.

questions.q: How can space technology help Bihar’s disaster and agriculture administration?
questions.solution: Flood inundation maps, crop insurance, weather nowcast. ISRO + state disaster authority. Last-mile is still the gram panchayat.

questions.q: Gangetic dolphin as a flagship — conservation challenges in Bihar.
questions.solution: Vikramshila sanctuary, river traffic, pollution, gill nets. Flagship for a living Ganga, not a poster only.
